declarations.docstring: A criterion for disjointness of a supremum of two submodules with a third submodule.
A surjective linear map has a bijective restriction to a submodule built from a family of simple submodules.
A family of simple submodules spanning the source yields a complement to the kernel of a linear map.
A surjection from a module spanned by simple submodules restricts to an A-linear equivalence on the sum of a selected subset of those submodules.
A surjection from an internal direct sum of simple submodules restricts to an A-linear equivalence on a direct sum of selected original summands.
A surjective linear map from a semisimple module has a submodule complementary to its kernel.
